# Customer (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Customer` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 7 actions on 3 resources, 3 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-customer) | `GET /customer?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}&IncludeDeprecated={IncludeDeprecated}&IncludeProductPrices={IncludeProductPrices}&ContactFilter={ContactFilter}` |
| [POST](#post-customer) | `POST /customer` |
| [PUT](#put-customer) | `PUT /customer` |
| [GET](#get-ref-customer-templates) | `GET /ref/customer/templates?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&CustomerId={CustomerId}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-customer-templates) | `POST /ref/customer/templates` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-customer-templates) | `DELETE /ref/customer/templates?TemplateId={TemplateId}&CustomerId={CustomerId}` |
| [GET](#get-ref-customer-credits) | `GET /ref/customer/credits?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&CustomerID={CustomerID}&ShowUsedCredits={ShowUsedCredits}` |


Customer CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Customer
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `ID`                  | Guid      |           | Yes       | Unique Customer ID.                                           |
| `Name`                | String    | 256       | Yes       | Customer name. Must be unique.                                             |
| `DisplayName`         | String    | 256       |           | Preferred customer name. Unlike `Name`, multiple customers can use this `DisplayName`. It does not need to be unique.                                             |
| `Status`              | String    |           | Yes*      | Points that Customer is Active. Available values are `Active` and `Deprecated`. Required for POST|
| `Currency`            | String    |           | Yes       | Currency code of Customer.                                    |
| `PaymentTerm`         | String    |           | Yes       | Payment term.                                                 |
| `AccountReceivable`   | String    |           | Yes       | Account receivable code of Customer.                          |
| `RevenueAccount`      | String    |           | Yes       | Sale account code of Customer.                                |
| `TaxRule`             | String    |           | Yes       | Tax rule name.                                                |
| `PriceTier`           | String    |           |           | Price tier.                                                   |
| `Carrier`             | String    |           |           | Carrier name.                                                 |
| `SalesRepresentative` | String    |           |           | Sales representative.                                         |
| `Location`            | String    |           |           | Location.                                                     |
| `Discount`            | Int       |           |           | Discount must be between 0% and 100%.                         |
| `Comments`            | String    | 2000       |           | Comments.                                                     |
| `TaxNumber`           | Int       |           |           | Tax number.                                                   |
| `CreditLimit`         | Int       |           |           | Credit limit.                                                 |
| `Tags`                | String    |           |           | Tags string.                                                  |
| `AttributeSet`        | String    |           |           | AttributeSet name.                                            |
| `AdditionalAttribute#`| String    |           |           | Additional attribute value. # - int(1-10).                    |
| `LastModifiedOn`      | String    |           |           | Date of last modification.                                    |
| `IsOnCreditHold`      | Bool      |           |           | Is On Credit Hold.                                    |
| `LastModifiedOn`      | DateTime      |           |           | Date of last modification. UTC Time. Read-only. |
| `IsLegalEntity`      | Bool      |           |           | `true` if a customer is a Legal Entity. Default `false`.  |
| `CustomerParentID`      | Guid      |           |           | The unique Customer ID for a parent customer or `null`.  |
| `CustomerParentName`      | String      | 256          |           | Name of the parent customer.   |
| `IsBillParent`      | Bool      |           |           | Default `false`. Not available if the Parent is empty or null. If `true`, Child uses the Parent's billing address and sales history.  |
| `ProductPrices`       |<a href="#ProductPriceModel"><b>[] Product Price Model</b></a>||| Customer specific Product Prices.         |
| `Addresses`           |<a href="#SupplierAddressModel"><b>[] Customer Address Model</b></a>||| List of addresses.         |
| `Contacts`            |<a href="#SupplierContactModel"><b>[] Customer Contact Model</b></a>||| List of contacts.          |
| `ChildCustomers`            |<a href="#ChildCustomerModel"><b>[] Child Customer Model</b></a>||| Customers’s child records (available only in the responses)       |

## Customer

Path: `/customer`

<a id="get-customer"></a>
### GET /customer?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}&IncludeDeprecated={IncludeDeprecated}&IncludeProductPrices={IncludeProductPrices}&ContactFilter={ContactFilter}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Customer with the specific ID
  - default: null
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Customers which name starts with the specific name
  - default: null
- `ContactFilter` (optional, string): Only return Customers which contact name starts with the specified value of contact email equals to specified value
  - default: null
- `ModifiedSince` (optional, DateTime?): Only return Customers modified since specified date (UTC time) in ISO 8601 format.
  - default: null
- `IncludeDeprecated` (optional, bool): Returns all Customers, including deprecated, if set to true. If set to false or if it is not specified then returns only active (ie. non-deprecated) Suppliers"
  - default: false
- `IncludeProductPrices` (optional, bool): Returns all Customers, including customer specific product prices, if set to true. If set to false or if it is not specified then no Product Prices will be returned."
  - default: false

## Customer Default Template

Path: `/ref/customer/templates`

### Available fields for Customer Default Template
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `CustomerID`  | Guid           |         |   Yes*  |  Customer ID. |
| `TemplateID`  | Guid           |         |   Yes*  | Template ID.  |

Customer Default Template CRUD Operations.

<a id="get-ref-customer-templates"></a>
### GET /ref/customer/templates?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&CustomerId={CustomerId}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `CustomerId` (optional, Guid): Only return Customer Default Templates for specified CustomerId.
  - default: null

<a id="get-ref-customer-credits"></a>

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `CustomerID` (optional, Guid): Only return Customer Credits for specified CustomerID.

- `ShowUsedCredits` (optional, Boolean): Return Customer Credits icluded already used.
